title: News & Updates
subtitle: What changed in the last 48 hours.

items.title: Start Here onboarding is now on Home.
items.summary: New users now get a simple first-run path: set up Account Wallet, fund or earn, check balances, then preview staking.

items.title: Participant UI is cleaner across the main tabs.
items.summary: Home, Earn, Buy VOID, Wallet, Trade, Stake, and the Account Wallet bar were simplified for normal users.

items.title: One-command participant UI regression proof is live.
items.summary: The participant page can now be checked with make participant-ui-cleanup-proof on Precision and Alienware.

items.title: Operator-only status chips were moved out of the normal top strip.
items.summary: Relayer and runner states no longer pollute the normal participant status bar; Trade still shows market readiness where it belongs.
